courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的隧道與地下設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring tunnels and underground works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 纖維噴射混凝土韌性試驗
related.transfer: 可遷移「薄殼受力與岩面接觸」與「芯樣方向與強度換算」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；纖維噴射混凝土韌性試驗的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Shell action and rock contact" and "Core orientation and strength interpretation" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Fiber-shotcrete toughness testing must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以早齡承載、基面黏結與厚度控制噴凝土支護；纖維噴射混凝土韌性試驗則以以裂後荷載、能量積分與取樣方向驗證纖維噴凝土為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on control shotcrete support through early strength, substrate bond and installed thickness; Fiber-shotcrete toughness testing centres on verify fibre shotcrete through postcrack load, energy integration and sampling direction, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「薄殼受力與岩面接觸」與「裂後承載與纖維橋接」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到纖維噴射混凝土韌性試驗，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「荷重位移同步與零點」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Shell action and rock contact” and “Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Fiber-shotcrete toughness testing, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Force-displacement synchronization and zero", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 隧道岩栓拉拔驗證
related.transfer: 可遷移「薄殼受力與岩面接觸」與「芯樣方向與強度換算」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；隧道岩栓拉拔驗證的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Shell action and rock contact" and "Core orientation and strength interpretation" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Tunnel rock-bolt pullout verification must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以早齡承載、基面黏結與厚度控制噴凝土支護；隧道岩栓拉拔驗證則以辨識岩栓鋼材、漿體與岩體界面的拉拔傳力為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on control shotcrete support through early strength, substrate bond and installed thickness; Tunnel rock-bolt pullout verification centres on distinguish bolt steel, grout and rock interfaces in pullout load transfer, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「薄殼受力與岩面接觸」與「岩楔荷重與岩栓方向」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到隧道岩栓拉拔驗證，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「持載位移與時間效應」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Shell action and rock contact” and “Wedge weight and bolt direction”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Tunnel rock-bolt pullout verification, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Hold movement and time effects", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 隧道噴射混凝土支護
history.text: 本課討論的以早齡承載、基面黏結與厚度控制噴凝土支護，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。噴層與岩塊、岩栓共同工作，空腔會改變受力路徑。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。哥達與英法海底隧道僅作地質及地下水邊界的比較，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: The focus on control shotcrete support through early strength, substrate bond and installed thickness reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. The layer interacts with rock blocks and bolts; cavities change its load path. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. Gotthard and the Channel Tunnel are comparisons of geological and groundwater boundaries only. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.
